messages:
sarah_support: FYI we just got a customer escalation — function/tool calling failures after a recent toolkit rename. They say calls to 'currency_convert' started failing with a 'tool_not_registered' error. Root message from customer pasted below.

customer: Hi, we're getting failures when using function calling to hit our conversion tool. Error: "tool_not_registered: currency_convert". This used to work yesterday. We didn't change our code. Request ID: r-8f3a2b.

sarah_support: Repro steps asked — asked them for a minimal curl and sample request, they sent this:```json
POST /v1/call-tool
{
  "model": "redwood-alpha:2025-04",
  "tool": "currency_convert",
  "input": { "amount": 100, "from": "USD", "to": "EUR" }
}
```

sarah_support: Response is 400 with body: ```json
{
  "error": {
    "type": "tool_not_registered",
    "message": "Tool 'currency_convert' not found in registry. Did you mean 'fx_convert'?"
  }
}
```

devin_sdk: I've seen this pattern — usually a registry sync or aliasing mismatch. Did they recently rename the tool?

customer: We did rename locally to fx_convert a week ago but we kept backward alias 'currency_convert' in our deploy config. We didn't touch the Redwood call.

maria_platform: Can you paste the control-plane registry snapshot for that org+team? I'm checking whether alias entries exist.

ops-bot: INFO: registry-sync-job for org:acme, team:payments ran at 2025-06-12T03:00:12Z. Status: FAILED (timeout).

devin_sdk: That rings alarm bells. If the control-plane sync failed, old aliases might have been purged or not propagated to runtime caches. Two likely failure modes: 1) registry rename removed alias but dashboard still shows it, 2) runtime cache not refreshed after rename.

james_cs: Customer is P2 but losing production conversion calls — they say 30% of their checkout flows hit this API. Escalating to eng-runtime. Tagging @devin_sdk @maria_platform.

devin_sdk: Quick repro locally: I hit the same curl but with tool name 'fx_convert' it succeeds. So this is consistent with a registry/name mismatch. Logging from runtime: ```
[2025-06-12T08:14:02Z] request r-8f3a2b tool=currency_convert user=acme-team handler=tool_router error=not_found
[2025-06-12T08:14:02Z] fallback_check aliases=[fx_convert] match_case_sensitive=false result=NO_MATCH
```

devin_sdk: Note the handler printed match_case_sensitive=false but still returned NO_MATCH — could be a bug in the alias lookup where casing or exact string comparison is enforced in some code path.

maria_platform: Looking at control-plane logs around sync job failure: ```
ERROR registry-sync: timeout waiting for rename propagation for org=acme team=payments job=sync-827
Trace: HTTP 504 from registry-db.aws.internal
```

sarah_support: Customer workaround requested — what can we tell them to unblock?

devin_sdk: Short-term: ask them to change caller to 'fx_convert' (fast). If they need immediate transparent fallback, we can create a temporary alias mapping on control plane for them — I'll add alias 'currency_convert' -> 'fx_convert' manually.

maria_platform: I'll queue an emergency alias create for org acme. Also re-run registry-sync-job once DB connectivity flake is resolved. Ops: can you confirm DB is healthy?

ops-bot: DB cluster payments-registry healthy=false. Recent maintenance caused transient 504s. Incident created: INC-4321.

james_cs: Messaging the customer: offer two options (1) quick code change to fx_convert, (2) temporary alias applied by platform (we'll notify once done).

customer: Please apply alias, we can't ship a code change right now.

maria_platform: Alias create in progress via control plane API: POST /internal/orgs/acme/aliases {"from":"currency_convert","to":"fx_convert"} -> 202 ACCEPTED. Should propagate to runtime within ~30s once sync job completes.

devin_sdk: Meanwhile filing an engineering bug: BUG-9987 - alias lookup case-insensitive/alias-propagation mismatch causing function calling failures after tool rename. Repro steps attached.

devin_sdk: Proposed long-term fixes: 1) make alias lookup tolerant to casing and whitespace, 2) add a fallback lookup against recent rename history, 3) surface registry-sync failures as higher-severity alerts so we don't silently lose aliases.

maria_platform: After alias create, runtime logs show: ```
[2025-06-12T08:16:37Z] alias_apply from=currency_convert to=fx_convert org=acme -> success
[2025-06-12T08:16:40Z] request r-8f3a2b tool=currency_convert -> routed to fx_convert handler
```

customer: Confirmed — calls succeed now. Thanks.

sarah_support: Closing loop: customer unblocked, alias applied, registry-sync root cause due to DB maintenance causing 504 timeouts. Action items: DEV: BUG-9987 (devin) SLA: improve monitoring for registry-sync (maria) OPS: root cause postmortem for payments-registry maintenance window (ops). I'll file a support ticket summary and link INC-4321 and BUG-9987. :thumbsup:

james_cs: Thanks team. We'll follow up with a short post to the changelog that renames should include alias verification steps for customers.

ops-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: INC-4321 -> resolved after DB maintenance rollback at 2025-06-12T09:05:12Z.

sarah_support: Marking thread resolved.
